So it is considered a simulcast on MTV. No advertisements promote MTV. Just like back in the day the ads didn't promote the show simulcast on the sister viacom networks. This also is so they can be in accordance with their cable carriage contracts to be able to have it on demand the next day on p+ (unlike something like Jersey shore family or rpdr)
another quick tweak as it's not a 'raw feed' on P+, but a viewer's local CBS station

For most purposes, a simulcast is considered 'carrying one program on multiple services at the same time, and that can be defined as a streaming service too, doesn't matter the distribution tech behind it
/* */ Paramount plus is not considered a simulcast. It is considered one of the two primary forms of distribution according to Paramount corporation

Reverting; it should be made absolutely clear that it requires P+ premium and noting that it airs on MTV is 100% expected and already properly sourced. Also, [[WP:OWN|anyone can edit this article]], including TAs and there's a nice and empty talk page to discuss that you forgot about before ANI
